info.title: Alerts & Waitlists API
info.description: Mode C API of Alerts & Waitlists (SSPS v1). All data lives in the merchant's own database; messages go through the merchant's own messaging connector. Money is integer minor units + ISO-4217 currency; times are ISO-8601 UTC; phones are E.164. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`type` ends with a stable code). POSTs that move state require `Idempotency-Key`; replays return the original response. Operations marked `x-ss-key-kind: sk` refuse browser (pk_) keys.

websiteKey.description: pk_ (browser, domain-locked; customer data only with the customer's own SS-Identity login token) or sk_ (server) website key

Identity.name: SS-Identity
Identity.description: the customer's own login token (bring-your-own identity; pk_ keys)

created.description: POST only: false when an active subscription was updated

itemId.description: `*` for a custom type without target

id.description: idempotency id of the change (default: the Idempotency-Key)

more.description: more waiters remain (continued by the next trigger of the website or a manual outbox run)

get.summary: Trigger runs, newest first (cursor pagination). sk_ only.

post.summary: Report one stock, price or custom change from your server (idempotent on `id` or the Idempotency-Key). Pending waiters whose condition now holds are claimed and alerted once. sk_ only.
Several changes in one call, per-item results (max triggers.max_batch_items). sk_ only.
CSV import of changes (header: kind,item_id,variant_id,location_id,quantity,previous_quantity,price,previous_price,currency,item_name,item_url; max triggers.max_csv_rows rows). sk_ only.

get.summary: Alert types the website offers and the form settings the widget needs (pk_ or sk_).
Subscriptions, newest first. pk_: only the signed-in customer's (SS-Identity; empty without). sk_: all, filtered by customerId, status, type, itemId (+variantId), email or phone; addresses included.

post.summary: Subscribe ("Notify me"). Browsers (pk_): the address comes from the signed-in customer (SS-Identity) or the typed e-mail / E.164 phone, consent required, rate-limited per IP and contact. Servers (sk_): any address, customerId and tier. Subscribing again updates the active subscription (200).

get.summary: One subscription (pk_: the signed-in customer's own only), with its waitlist position.

delete.summary: Stop one subscription (pk_: the signed-in customer's own; soft: status unsubscribed).

post.summary: Confirm a double opt-in from your own page (token from the confirmation link).

get.summary: The outbox, newest first (addresses masked). sk_ only.

post.summary: Run the outbox now (also done right after each trigger while inline dispatch is on): repair stale claims, continue open trigger runs, send due messages (claim before send). sk_ only.
Dashboard "Send due now" (SSO session, merchant roles): the same outbox run as POST /v1/messages:dispatch for the session's website.

get.summary: A waitlist in order (pending subscriptions of a type and target: rank, then time). sk_ only.
Position of a subscription in its waitlist (pk_: the signed-in customer's own).

post.summary: Unsubscribe with the token of an unsubscribe link (for your own confirm page; unsubscribe.page_url). Scope per unsubscribe.scope.

get.summary: What an unsubscribe token would stop (no change — safe for link previews).
Report of a window (days ≤ analytics.max_window_days): subscriptions by type/status, messages by channel/status, rates in basis points, daily series. sk_ only.
Hosted confirm page of an unsubscribe link (HTML). Shows a button only — link previews never unsubscribe.

post.summary: Apply the unsubscribe (the page's form; also RFC 8058 one-click `List-Unsubscribe=One-Click` from mail clients).

get.summary: Hosted confirm page of a double opt-in link (HTML; no change on GET).
What this website has enabled (from the cached signed document).
Effective configuration of the requested elements (?element=a,b).

post.summary: Push events of the product namespace or consumed types (dispatched like Event Hub deliveries).
